# PR checklist (quick copy)

- Title: Improve CI, add linters, CodeQL, Dependabot, and docs
- Description: See PULL_REQUEST_BODY.md in the repo root (this branch)

Steps to open PR locally on GitHub UI:
1. Visit: https://github.com/abucaria-afk/Social-media/pull/new/improve/ci-and-docs
2. Paste the contents of PULL_REQUEST_BODY.md into the PR description if GitHub does not prefill it.
3. Assign reviewers (optional), set labels, and create the PR.
4. Wait for checks to complete and review any failures before merging.
